key: Blood for blood, as always.
en: Blood for blood, as always.
ja: 血には血を、いつもそうだ。

key: The city bleeds, and so to staunch the wound, we cut into the wildlife.
en: The city bleeds, and so to staunch the wound, we cut into the wildlife.
ja: 街が血を流すからこそ、その傷を止めるために、我々は野生の命を切り刻む。

key: So Reborn never changes...
en: So Reborn never changes...
ja: リボーンは決して変わらない……

key: Maybe that man from Team Meteor was onto something.
en: Maybe that man from Team Meteor was onto something.
ja: あのチームメテオの男は、何か真実を見抜いていたのかもしれないな。

key: It's a pity that Reborn has had to cut into the trees here to support the city's reconstruction, but I'm sure it's for the best.
en: It's a pity that Reborn has had to cut into the trees here to support the city's reconstruction, but I'm sure it's for the best.
ja: 街の再建を支えるためにここの木々を切らざるを得ないのは残念だが、きっとそれが最善なんだろう。

key: Though honestly, you'd think they'd have had enough trees from the ones that grew all over the city.
en: Though honestly, you'd think they'd have had enough trees from the ones that grew all over the city.
ja: 正直、街中に生えてた木だけでも十分だったと思うけどな。

key: Many of those were transplanted into the city's various parks, but I suppose even that wasn't enough.
en: Many of those were transplanted into the city's various parks, but I suppose even that wasn't enough.
ja: その多くは街の様々な公園に移植されたが、それでも足りなかったらしい。

key: Did you need anything? If not, could you let us be?
en: Did you need anything? If not, could you let us be?
ja: 何か用か?なければ放っておいてくれないか?

key: Beat it kid, we're working here.
en: Beat it kid, we're working here.
ja: 失せろ坊主、こっちは仕事中なんだ。

key: We've got a lot of wood to process here; shove off.
en: We've got a lot of wood to process here; shove off.
ja: 処理する木材が山ほどあるんだ、どいてくれ。

key: SANDY: There you are!
en: SANDY: There you are!
ja: サンディ: いた!

key: I got nervous when I saw there were so many of them, but we should be able to handle this... Right?
en: I got nervous when I saw there were so many of them, but we should be able to handle this... Right?
ja: あんなに大勢いるのを見て緊張しちゃったけど、これなら対処できるはず……よね?

key: C'mon, deep breath... I can do this.
en: C'mon, deep breath... I can do this.
ja: よし、深呼吸……あたしならできる。

key: This is for the Pokémon...
en: This is for the Pokémon...
ja: これはポケモンたちのため……

key: Let's go!
en: Let's go!
ja: 行くよ!

key: SANDY: Excuse me!
en: SANDY: Excuse me!
ja: サンディ: 失礼!

key: On behalf of all the Pokémon living in this forest...
en: On behalf of all the Pokémon living in this forest...
ja: この森に住むすべてのポケモンに代わって……

key: I'll punish you!
en: I'll punish you!
ja: あなたたちを懲らしめてやる!

key: Uhh...
en: Uhh...
ja: うう……

key: So, my shift still doesn't end for another couple hours...
en: So, my shift still doesn't end for another couple hours...
ja: ええと、おれのシフトが終わるまでまだ数時間あるんだけど……

key: SANDY: Yes! That one's for the future!
en: SANDY: Yes! That one's for the future!
ja: サンディ: よし!これは未来のための一撃!

key: Now go home and rethink your destructive ways!
en: Now go home and rethink your destructive ways!
ja: さあ、家に帰って自分たちのやってきた破壊的な行いを見つめ直しなさい!

key: HARD HAT: That's them; those are the ones causing a disturbance.
en: HARD HAT: That's them; those are the ones causing a disturbance.
ja: ハードハット: あいつらだ、騒ぎを起こしてるのは。

key: ADRIENN: I... \PN?
en: ADRIENN: I... \PN?
ja: アドリエンヌ: 私……\PN?

key: SANDY: Um.... Mx. Flores?
en: SANDY: Um.... Mx. Flores?
ja: サンディ: あの……フローレスさん?

key: Ah, this is lucky!
en: Ah, this is lucky!
ja: ああ、これはついてる!

key: I just need a moment of your time to talk about the deforestation of Malchous and other environmental concerns following the city's restoration.
en: I just need a moment of your time to talk about the deforestation of Malchous and other environmental concerns following the city's restoration.
ja: マルコウスの森林伐採と、街の復興に伴うその他の環境問題について、少しお時間をいただきたいんです。

key: ADRIENN: And you must be... the Reserve Ground Leader, Sandy.
en: ADRIENN: And you must be... the Reserve Ground Leader, Sandy.
ja: アドリエンヌ: あなたは……自然保護区のリーダー、サンディさんですね。

key: I heard that you were like this.
en: I heard that you were like this.
ja: あなたがこういう方だとは聞いていました。

key: SANDY: That's right, but what's important is that you take action to ensure the safety of our world.
en: SANDY: That's right, but what's important is that you take action to ensure the safety of our world.
ja: サンディ: そのとおりです、でも大事なのは、あなたが私たちの世界の安全を守るために行動を起こすことです。

key: I've submitted several petitions in due process asking for a reformation of several policies to better the--
en: I've submitted several petitions in due process asking for a reformation of several policies to better the--
ja: 正規の手続きを経て、いくつもの政策の改革を求める請願書を提出しています、よりよくするために――

key: ADRIENN: Yes, yes-- I've read them.
en: ADRIENN: Yes, yes-- I've read them.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ええ、ええ――読みましたよ。

key: I understand your concerns, but in each case, it's not as simple as just immediately throwing people at the issue.
en: I understand your concerns, but in each case, it's not as simple as just immediately throwing people at the issue.
ja: あなたの懸念は理解していますが、どの件も、すぐさま人を投入すれば解決するというほど単純な話ではないのです。

key: We'll keep working towards a satisfactory solution, but in the meantime...
en: We'll keep working towards a satisfactory solution, but in the meantime...
ja: 満足のいく解決に向けて努力し続けますが、その間――

key: Could I ask you to not accost the city workers?
en: Could I ask you to not accost the city workers?
ja: 街の作業員たちに詰め寄るのはやめていただけませんか。

key: They're just working towards a wage; it's not their decision how much of Malchous is used.
en: They're just working towards a wage; it's not their decision how much of Malchous is used.
ja: 彼らはただ賃金のために働いているだけで、マルコウスをどれだけ使うかを決めているわけではありません。

key: And for the record, I understand that most of these trees were generated by the PULSE incident in this area.
en: And for the record, I understand that most of these trees were generated by the PULSE incident in this area.
ja: それに、念のため言っておきますが、これらの木の多くはこの地域で起きたパルス事件によって生まれたものだと理解しています。

key: Our priority has always been to use up that artificially augmented plant life for its resources before cutting into the natural environment.
en: Our priority has always been to use up that artificially augmented plant life for its resources before cutting into the natural environment.
ja: 私たちの優先事項は常に、自然環境に手をつける前に、その人工的に増強された植物を資源として使い切ることでした。

key: And in any case, the simple fact is that large construction projects will require a lot of wood.
en: And in any case, the simple fact is that large construction projects will require a lot of wood.
ja: それに、大規模な建設事業には大量の木材が必要になるという単純な事実もあります。

key: If you understand, then I'll ask for your patience in resolving these matters properly.
en: If you understand, then I'll ask for your patience in resolving these matters properly.
ja: ご理解いただけるなら、この問題を正しく解決するまで、少し辛抱していただけますか。

key: Men, why don't you go ahead and take a break?
en: Men, why don't you go ahead and take a break?
ja: みんな、少し休憩を取ってはどうだ?

key: And, \PN?
en: And, \PN?
ja: それと、\PN?

key: Keep an eye on her for me, please.
en: Keep an eye on her for me, please.
ja: 彼女のこと、少し見ておいてもらえますか。

key: SANDY: Well... Okay.
en: SANDY: Well... Okay.
ja: サンディ: まあ……わかりました。

key: Maybe that was a little hasty, but...
en: Maybe that was a little hasty, but...
ja: ちょっと性急だったかもしれないけど……

key: I'm gonna mark that down as a partial success!
en: I'm gonna mark that down as a partial success!
ja: これは半分成功ってことにしとこう!

key: Now, what to do next...
en: Now, what to do next...
ja: さて、次は何をしようかな……

key: Mm... I know!
en: Mm... I know!
ja: うーん……そうだ!

key: Azurine Lake has really cleared up ever since the Water Treatment Center came back online...
en: Azurine Lake has really cleared up ever since the Water Treatment Center came back online...
ja: アズリン湖は浄水センターが再稼働してからすっかりきれいになったけど……

key: But the truth is, some of the chemicals used to "clean" it are actually still harmful to the Pokémon!
en: But the truth is, some of the chemicals used to "clean" it are actually still harmful to the Pokémon!
ja: でも実は、湖を「浄化」するのに使われてる薬品の一部が、まだポケモンには有害なんだよね!

key: Thanks to an anonymous source, I was able to acquire an alternate filter to apply to the main head of the Treatment Center...
en: Thanks to an anonymous source, I was able to acquire an alternate filter to apply to the main head of the Treatment Center...
ja: 匿名の情報源のおかげで、浄水センターの主要な取水口に取り付けられる代替フィルターを手に入れられたの……

key: I think it will go a long way to protecting the Pokémon of the lake!
en: I think it will go a long way to protecting the Pokémon of the lake!
ja: これがあれば湖のポケモンを守るのに大いに役立つはず!

key: Meet me at the central part of the Water Treatment Center, in the Opal Grid!
en: Meet me at the central part of the Water Treatment Center, in the Opal Grid!
ja: 浄水センターの中心部、オパール水路網で会いましょう!

key: We'll protect the lake together!
en: We'll protect the lake together!
ja: 一緒に湖を守りましょうね!

key: CORIN-ROUGE: A-ha!
en: CORIN-ROUGE: A-ha!
ja: コリン・ルージュ: ああ!

key: My dashing dame!
en: My dashing dame!
ja: 我が麗しの淑女よ!

key: My glorious goddess!
en: My glorious goddess!
ja: 我が輝ける女神よ!

key: You've found me at last!
en: You've found me at last!
ja: とうとう私を見つけましたね!

key: Or have you?
en: Or have you?
ja: いや、本当にそうでしょうか?

key: As if the real Corin-Rouge would be caught so easily!
en: As if the real Corin-Rouge would be caught so easily!
ja: 本物のコリン・ルージュが、そう易々と捕まるはずがありません!

key: However! If you are able to defeat me, I'll give you a hint as to where the real one might be!
en: However! If you are able to defeat me, I'll give you a hint as to where the real one might be!
ja: だが、しかし!もしあなたが私を倒すことができれば、本物の居場所についてヒントを差し上げましょう!

key: Ah, ah, but strength alone is not enough to win~
en: Ah, ah, but strength alone is not enough to win~
ja: ああ、ああ、しかし勝負に勝つには強さだけでは足りませんよ～

key: Aha~ As expected from a damsel as radiant as yourself!
en: Aha~ As expected from a damsel as radiant as yourself!
ja: ああ～さすがはあなたのように輝かしいご令嬢だ!

key: But I am a man of honor, and I shall never break a promise to a lady.
en: But I am a man of honor, and I shall never break a promise to a lady.
ja: しかし私は誉れある男。淑女への約束を破ることは決してありません。

key: As such, I'll generously give you a hint about the whereabouts of the real Corin-Rouge...
en: As such, I'll generously give you a hint about the whereabouts of the real Corin-Rouge...
ja: というわけで、本物のコリン・ルージュの居場所について、気前よくヒントを差し上げましょう……

key: Hm, not bad.
en: Hm, not bad.
ja: ふむ、なかなかやりますね。

key: As promised, I'll give you a hint about the whereabouts of the real Corin-Rouge...
en: As promised, I'll give you a hint about the whereabouts of the real Corin-Rouge...
ja: 約束どおり、本物のコリン・ルージュの居場所についてヒントを差し上げます……

key: Find him buried in a pocket of peonies!
en: Find him buried in a pocket of peonies!
ja: シャクヤクの茂みの中に埋もれた彼を見つけてください!

key: That's all you'll get from me!
en: That's all you'll get from me!
ja: 私から差し上げられるのはこれだけです!
